scope: Local release-candidate packaging and receipt-readiness review only; no production database access, migration, exception activation, deployment, credential retrieval or backup creation

candidate.packageVerification: readPackage verified the package digest and every embedded file checksum
candidate.comparisonToArchivedReviewPackage: All 168 embedded file paths and SHA-256 values matched the retained review package from main commit 6a5f06d58c4414b7a0f584eeaede3118d3e9066b; the package commit metadata differs
candidate.localStorage: Owner-only 0700 directory and 0600 package/checksum files under /private/tmp; temporary, not an independent durable backup

receiptReadiness.ciStep: Verify archived migration execution and receipts on PostgreSQL 18: success
receiptReadiness.productionReceipts: Not created; the runner creates started.json, package.json, before.json when preflight passes, and receipt.json per attempt only when authorized against the target
receiptReadiness.privateCustody: A separate durable private copy of the final package and future preflight/execute receipt directories remains unverified

finalReleaseBoundary: A final production package requires a separately reviewed and approved activation change to the reconciliation manifest status and both digest pins, a reviewed commit on main, a new Archive migration release run for that exact main SHA, and independent checksum/copy verification. The current candidate must not be used for production.
remainingPrivateEvidence: Founder and recovery-operator identities, independent retrieval of existing recovery keys, final package/receipt backup, and change-window restore point remain pending owner-controlled verification; record only redacted pass/fail metadata in public documentation.
